Footer layout adaptation

Native HTML/CSS adaptation of Footer / footer-01 by nevsky118, as linked from
https://21st.dev/@nevsky118/components/footer
Public source: https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/pull/6395/files
The original brand/social-navigation/copyright structure was adapted to this
portfolio. Placeholder social and legal links were replaced with real site actions.

Design references (no source copied)

Original native implementations inspired by:
- How It Works by chamaac: https://21st.dev/@chamaac/components/how-it-works
- Gooey Blobs by animbits: https://21st.dev/@animbits/components/loaders-gooey-blobs
- Parallax Scroll Feature Section by Sumona Biswas:
  https://21st.dev/@sumonadotwork/components/parallax-scroll-feature-section

Their 21st.dev component source required an account and was not copied.
